facts.text: Tim expressed eagerness to try the recipe and thanked John for sharing it.

evidence.quote: Can't wait to try it. Thanks for sharing the recipe!

facts.text: John expressed hope that Tim would enjoy the recipe and invited Tim to provide feedback.

evidence.quote: Hope you enjoy it! Let me know how it turns out.

facts.text: Tim confirmed he would provide feedback on the recipe and thanked John again before ending the conversation.

evidence.quote: Sure thing! Thanks. Great talking to you. Take care!

facts.text: John expressed satisfaction with the conversation and indicated he would speak to Tim later.

evidence.quote: It was nice chatting with you. Talk to you later!
